ANTH 1010G.title: Social Cultural Anthropology
ANTH 1010G.prereqText: ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C+ or higher

BIOL 1610.title: College Biology I
BIOL 1610.precoreqText: ACT (or equivalent) composite score of 21+, or ENGH 1005 or ENGL1010 (or higher); BIOL 1615

BIOL 1610H.title: College Biology I
BIOL 1610H.precoreqText: ACT (or equivalent) composite score of 21+, or ENGH 1005 or ENGL1010 (or higher); BIOL 1615 ( BIOL 1615 is recommended, but not required for pre-nursing or pre-dental hygiene majors.)

BIOL 1620.title: College Biology II
BIOL 1620.prereqText: BIOL 1610 and BIOL 1615 with a C- or higher in each.

BIOL 3400.title: Cell Biology
BIOL 3400.prereqText: ( BIOL 1610 or BIOL 1610H ) and ( CHEM 1110 or CHEM 1210 ) with a C- or higher in each and University Advanced Standing.

BIOL 3405.title: Cell Biology Laboratory
BIOL 3405.prereqText: BIOL 1610 and CHEM 1220 or higher with minimum grade of C- in each and University Advanced Standing

BIOL 3500.title: Genetics
BIOL 3500.prereqText: BIOL 1610 with minimum grade of C- and University Advanced Standing

CHEM 1110.title: Elementary Chemistry for the Health Sciences
CHEM 1110.precoreqText: MAT 1010 or MAT 2015 or STAT 1040 or STAT 1045 , or a placement score into MATH 1050 or higher.

CHEM 1210.title: Principles of Chemistry I
CHEM 1210.prereqText: MATH 1080 , MATH 1050 , MATH 1055 or any higher MATH course with a C- or better, or appropriate placement scores for MATH 1060 or higher. Also, it is highly recommended to have prior chemistry experience in high school or in CHEM 1010

CHEM 1220.title: Principles of Chemistry II
CHEM 1220.prereqText: CHEM 1210 with a grade of C- or higher

CHEM 1225.title: Principles of Chemistry II Laboratory
CHEM 1225.prereqText: CHEM 1215 with a C- or better

CHEM 2310.title: Organic Chemistry I
CHEM 2310.prereqText: CHEM 1220 with a grade of C- or higher

CHEM 2320.title: Organic Chemistry II
CHEM 2320.prereqText: CHEM 2310 & CHEM 2315 with a C- or higher

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.
prereqWords: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H with a grade of C- or higher, or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C or higher.

MAT 1030.title: Quantitative Reasoning
MAT 1030.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 1020 (preferred), or MAT1015 or MAT 1010 with a grade of C– or higher; or appropriate placement by a placement exam.
prereqWords: appropriate placement by a placement exam

MAT 1035.title: Quantitative Reasoning with Integrated Algebra
MAT 1035.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 0950 with a grade of C- or higher, or MAT 0980 with a grade of C- or higher, or appropriate placement by a placement exam.
prereqWords: appropriate placement by a placement exam

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1055.title: College Algebra with Preliminaries
MATH 1055.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1060.title: Trigonometry
MATH 1060.prereqText: Within the past two years: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1210.title: Calculus I
MATH 1210.prereqText: One of the following within the past two years: ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ) and MATH 1060 , each with a grade of C or higher; OR MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher; OR appropriate placement by math placement test.
prereqWords: appropriate placement by math placement test

MICR 2060.title: Microbiology for Health Professions
MICR 2060.prereqText: BIOL 1610 and ( ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 ) with a C- or higher in each. CHEM 1110 or higher is highly recommended

MICR 2065.title: Microbiology for Health Professions Laboratory
MICR 2065.prereqText: ( BIOL 1010 or BIOL 1610 ) and ( ENGL 1010 or ENGH 1005 ). CHEM 1110 highly recommended

STAT 1040.title: Introduction to Statistics
STAT 1040.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score
prereqWords: an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years)
appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score

STAT 1045.title: Introduction to Statistics with Algebra
STAT 1045.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score
prereqWords: an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years)
appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score

STAT 2040.title: Principles of Statistics
STAT 2040.prereqText: Within the past two years, MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement test score.

ZOOL 2420.title: Human Physiology
ZOOL 2420.prereqText: BIOL 1610 with a minimum grade of C- and CHEM 1110 or CHEM 1210 with a minimum grade of C-

ZOOL 4400.title: Pathophysiology
ZOOL 4400.prereqText: ZOOL 2320 , ZOOL 2420 , and MICR 2060 or MICR 3450 each with a minimum grade C-, and University Advanced Standing

ZOOL 4700.title: Advanced Anatomy
ZOOL 4700.prereqText: ZOOL 2320 with a minimum grade of C- and University Advanced Standing

admissionNote: Additionally, the program provides a customizable bachelor-level degree option in health for those who are not accepted into the competitive and limited healthcare cohort programs at the university and allows for pathway development opportunities with other institutions.
